fields.name: Characters
fields.evidence: Server character manager update bg3.exe+0x332FF50 (macOS esv::CharacterManager::Update / HandleJustDiedCharacter take this singleton in their WorldView) gets or creates the singleton (bg3.exe+0x3336370 on a new entity), compares 8-byte entity handles from its queries against the array (pointer +0, size +0xC) to avoid duplicates, appends the new ones with stride 8, then walks the array resolving each element to a character (FUN_140b21680 / esv::Task::GetCharacter) and finally sets the size (+0xC) to 0. Live: 5 instances, heap pointer, capacity up to 185, size 0.
